# Overview

This module focuses on understanding the distribution and characteristics of individual variables using exploratory data analysis (EDA). As there are no predefined benchmarks, confirmatory analysis will not be applicable.

# Packages Required

| Package | Reason for selection |
|----|----|
| **tidyverse** | Selected as the core package for data manipulation, cleaning, and visualisation (dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr) |


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggplot2)
df <- read_csv("COFINFAD_LAB/data/cleaned_data.csv")
```
:::


# Demographics

This section examines the distribution of demographic variables that describe the characteristics of the customer base. The variables include *age*, *gender*, *location*, *income_bracket*, *education_level*, *marital_status*, *occupation*, and *household_size*.

We use bar charts for categorical variables to understand the composition of the customer base.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
gender_counts <- df %>%
  count(gender)

ggplot(gender_counts, aes(x = gender, y = n)) + 
  geom_col(fill = "#3498db") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(x = "Gender", y = "Number of Customers") +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Univariate_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){fig-align='center' width=672}
:::
:::


# Transaction Behaviour

This section explores variables related to customer financial activity. Key variables include *tx_count*, *avg_tx_value*, *total_tx_volume, preferred_transaction_type, avg_daily_transactions,* and *weekend_transaction_ratio.*

We use histograms to examine distributions, along with bar charts for categorical variables such as transaction type.

::: panel-tabset
## Histogram


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_tx_value)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#2ecc71", bins = 30) +
  labs(x = "Average Transaction Value", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Univariate_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){fig-align='center' width=672}
:::
:::


## Bar Chart


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
ggplot(df, aes(x = preferred_transaction_type)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#2ecc71") +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Preferred Transaction Type", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Univariate_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){fig-align='center' width=672}
:::
:::

:::

# Product Ownership

This section analyses the distribution of financial products held by customers. Relevant variables include *savings_account*, *credit_card*, *personal_loan*, *investment_account*, *insurance_product*, and *active_products*.

We use bar charts to analyse adoption of financial products.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
ggplot(df, aes(x = active_products)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#e67e22") +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Number of Active Products", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Univariate_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){fig-align='center' width=672}
:::
:::


# App Usage and Engagement

This section examines variables related to customer interaction with the digital platform. These include *app_logins_frequency*, *feature_usage_diversity*, *bill_payment_user*, *auto_savings_enabled*.

We use bar charts to analyse platform engagement features.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
ggplot(df, aes(x = app_logins_frequency)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#1abc9c") +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "App Logins Freqeuncy", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Univariate_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){fig-align='center' width=672}
:::
:::


# Customer Satisfaction

This section explores customer experience indicators including *satisfaction_score*, *nps_score*, *base_satisfaction, tx_satisfaction, product_satisfaction,* *app_store_rating*, *feedback_sentiment*.

We use histograms to examine distributions, along with bar charts for categorical variables such as satisfaction score.

::: panel-tabset
## Histogram


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
ggplot(df, aes(x = base_satisfaction)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#9b59b6", bins = 30) +
  labs(x = "Base Satisfaction ", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
